subject: general
question: If each digit of the number 72514368 is subtracted from 9, how many even digits will be there in the newly formed number?
solution:
Given: 72514368

If each digit of the given number is subtracting from 9 then every number in the series will be:

2 7 4 8 5 6 3 1

Even digits in the newly formed number:

2 4 8 6

So, total 4 even digit number formed after arrangement

Hence, correct option is **"option 1)"**.
